verified_facts.text: The hotel is located close to the Champs-Elysées and the Arc de Triomphe.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ideally located close to the Champs-Elysées and Arc de Triomphe, our five-star hotel welcomes you with contemporary decor and luxury accommodations.

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites were designed by Alexandre Danan.

verified_facts.text: The rooms feature Venetian frescoes on the ceiling.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lay back and enjoy the Venetian frescoes on the ceiling, as well as premium amenities, Byredo products, and complimentary Wi-Fi.

verified_facts.text: Golden Keys concierges provide tailored tips and can create a guest's itinerary, including restaurant reservations and show and exhibit tickets.
verified_facts.excerpt: From making reservations at the best restaurants in town to finding tickets to must-see shows and exhibits, our team will create your perfect itinerary.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers Incredible Occasions, bespoke celebrations crafted in-room or in exclusive settings, such as birthday surprises, proposals and anniversaries.
